control_gate.rule: an arm passes the incremental gate iff its BTC-beta-context weekly excess is positive in >= 2 of the 3 frozen chronological folds (Stage-A, unrelaxed); the raw excess vs the BTCUSDT buy-and-hold benchmark must additionally be positive in >= 2/3 folds for the family to advance

price_only_clause.rule: price-only expectancy <= 0 while total expectancy is positive only through native funding credits => the mechanism is a carry harvest, not a price-unwind mechanism; family REJECTED as declared ex ante (proposal sections 2(e)/9; V6 adjacency).  The price-only / total split is computed by the scored layer and applied by research.v14.families.basislv_premfade.gate_runner; it is never computed in this package.

basislv_premfade.price_only_clause_required_input: the scored layer (Phase E) computes the price-only vs total expectancy split per arm and passes it here; this module never computes it
basislv_premfade.control_rule: control MUST NOT reproduce the anchor: if BASISLV-PREMFADE-28D-INV passes the same incremental gate (BTC-beta-context excess positive in >= 2/3 folds) while the anchor passes, the premium ordering carries no directional crowding information, any anchor result is a generic tilt/cost artifact, the anchor FAILS and the family is rejected; the control is never promotable to a family regardless of its own result
basislv_premfade.neighbour_rule: the neighbour (BASISLV-PREMFADE-56D) supports the mechanism iff it shows the same sign (incremental gate passed); a flipped/failed neighbour means the premium level is formation-window fragile -- not the persistent crowding state the mechanism requires -- and the family is rejected
basislv_premfade.stress_rule: anchor passes base but fails stress => spread/slippage execution artifact; family rejected (proposal section 9; evaluated by the scored layer's stress set)
basislv_premfade.reason: anchor passes the incremental gate, the price-only clause does not fire, the sign-inverted control does not reproduce it, and the 56d neighbour supports the sign

basislv_fold_concentration.rule: largest fold-positive share of PnL <= 50%; a larger share is a single-regime artifact and falsifies (OICYC.md falsifier 5)
